metadata.name: High-Precision GNSS Survey Observations, Elwha River Delta Campaign, March 20, 2011
metadata.description: This dataset contains 211 high-precision GNSS survey observations collected during a single survey session on March 20, 2011. The data includes latitude, longitude, and elevation coordinates, along with horizontal and vertical root mean square (HRMS/VRMS) error estimates and solution status. All observations feature a 'FIXED' GNSS solution status, indicating centimeter-level positioning accuracy. The survey was conducted in a compact area off the coast of Vancouver Island, British Columbia.
metadata.spatial: Point locations with centimeter-level precision (approx. 0.01 m)
